evaluation-system.goal: Evaluate agent session quality, calibrate criteria, detect drift, patrol integrity, extract strategies
evaluation-system.summary: Project-app evaluation system with five lanes. Current owner focus is split between the older aftermath trigger-leak audit and a fresh aftermath liveness gap: the live 3h metric alert is now at 0, and the current window shows no evaluation.routed / evaluation.reviewed / evaluation.skipped activity despite ongoing session completions. Keep pipeline-health active on trigger/dispatch liveness first, then resume secondary lanes once the zero-activity window is explained or repaired.

pipeline-health.goal: Monitor evaluation pipeline: is aftermath keeping up? Are there gaps? Is LLM lane useful?
pipeline-health.summary: Pipeline-health now has two active signals. Historical evidence still points at missing-sessionId routing leakage, but the current live breach has shifted again: metric evaluator.aftermath-coverage-rate-3h is now 0, and the measured 3h window shows zero evaluation.routed / evaluation.reviewed / evaluation.skipped events even though 29 sessions completed in that same window. That means the immediate issue is broader aftermath trigger/dispatch liveness, not just post-review delivery matching.

aftermath-trigger-leak-audit.goal: Identify why evaluator-aftermath still receives triggers without a concrete sessionId and package the smallest fix or escalation.
acceptance: Quantifies which trigger/event shapes are producing the missing-sessionId escalations now.
Identifies the exact upstream emitter or dispatch path responsible for the leak.
Packages the next action as either a local implementation task or a concrete escalation with evidence.

latest_evidence.signal: The leak is still active and now better scoped. In the last 24h, 84 of 85 missing-sessionId escalations still embed a full ## Trigger Event whose data.sessionId should be parseable by evaluator-aftermath, which keeps evaluator-side trigger extraction/routing the primary suspect. One fresh escalation still uses the generic periodic aftermath task text with no parentSessionId, parentWorkflowRunId, or projectId, so the audit should also trace whether any stale legacy dispatcher still emits bare aftermath work.

aftermath-reviewer-runtime-failures.goal: Reduce evaluator review-failed escalations caused by unavailable evaluator runtime dependencies or provider capacity.
acceptance: Classifies the current failure modes (for example 429 no deployment, 401 token expired, missing python/command assumptions) with concrete session evidence.
Separates evaluator-owned prompt/workflow fixes from runtime-owner issues.
Leaves a concrete repair or escalation task instead of a generic complaint.

latest_evidence.signal: The previously observed evaluator review-failed escalations are not present in the current 24h or 72h window, so this lane is no longer the best use of active attention. Keep it parked in backlog and resume if review-failed escalations recur; current pipeline-health work should stay focused on the missing-sessionId leak, with interrupted runs noted separately as restart noise unless they become the primary failure mode.

criteria-and-calibration.goal: Maintain scoring criteria, calibrate against human reviews, version criteria changes
criteria-and-calibration.summary: Criteria at v1. Calibration scaffolding exists but criteria/calibration is empty and the prior summary references only 2026-04-29 placeholder stubs. A fresh 2026-06 disagreement sample is needed before criteria changes are credible.

seed-fresh-calibration-batch.goal: Build a fresh calibration baseline from current 2026-06 evaluations instead of relying on placeholder stubs.
acceptance: Samples recent sessions with disagreement or false-good risk from the live DB.
Records at least one real calibration artifact under criteria/calibration or explains why a different durable location is better.
Updates task-tree context with what the new sample says about criteria drift.

drift-detection.goal: Detect per-agent behavioral drift. Classify: natural evolution vs regression.

system-integrity.goal: Patrol system compliance. Monitor active session health. Flag anomalies.
system-integrity.summary: Patrol currently returns CRITICAL only for missing compliance-snapshot.json (known baseline gap).

strategy-learning.goal: Extract successful strategies from high-scoring sessions. Feed back into agent guidance.

aftermath-reviewed-delivery-gap.goal: Identify why evaluator-aftermath is producing no routed/reviewed/skipped activity in the live alert window despite ongoing session completions, and package the smallest repair or escalation.
acceptance: Verifies the current 3h breach against the measured window and confirms whether aftermath events are absent or merely unmatched.
Explains whether the zero-coverage gap is upstream trigger loss, handler dispatch failure, or evaluator workflow inactivity.
Leaves either a local repair task or a concrete escalation with named timestamps/session samples and evidence.

latest_evidence.signal: The live breach is no longer a total evaluator outage, but direct session.completed -> evaluator-aftermath dispatch still appears absent. In the measured 3h window, 271 session.completed events were accepted by cron:1, no direct-trigger evaluator-aftermath runs started, and only thin scan/backfill activity produced 4 routed / 4 reviewed / 5 skipped outcomes. Checked-in platform code now shows project-app workflow-handler pre-registration in project-app-loader.ts, so the active problem is a runtime deployment/loader contradiction or another dispatch bypass, not just stale task context about reviewed-event matching.

replace-heartbeat-with-owner-planner.goal: Replace genericHeartbeat with a bounded owner-planner workflow that reads the task tree and acts within it. The current heartbeat creates standalone projects (20+ deleted manually). Metric breaches should become task-tree entries, not new projects.

context.current_problem: evaluator-heartbeat.ts uses genericHeartbeat which gives full creative freedom. The evaluator discovers metric issues and creates projects/evaluator-*/project.md files instead of updating evaluation.app/tasks/tree.json.
context.fix_direction: Replace genericHeartbeat with a workflow like aks-rp-e2e's project-planner: read task tree packet, review completions, create tasks for new findings, assign runnable work. Same pattern, evaluation domain.
context.disabled: evaluation-pipeline-review schedule (5min) disabled until this migration is done. drift-detection (1h) and integrity-patrol (6h) still run genericHeartbeat but at lower frequency.

acceptance: No more standalone evaluator-* projects created
Metric findings become task tree entries under appropriate lanes
Owner wake reads task tree packet, reviews state, creates/assigns work
evaluation-pipeline-review re-enabled with bounded planner workflow
